title: Gameplay Reel (grown-ups)
content:
This one's not for your kid. It's for you. 🍎

Your child comes home deflated. What do you say first? The Grown-Up stories put you in the choice seat, and if the first thing you'd say isn't the one that helps, you just… try again. No judgment, no lecture.

Practice the hard conversations before you're in one. The Grown-Up series is part of the Lab membership; the six free stories show you exactly how it feels.
▶️ mccraylearninglab.com (IG: link in bio)

title: Card 1 — Train Like a Champion
content:
Moment: When they say 'I can't'
Say: "Add one little word. I can't win… YET."

title: Card 10 — The Empty Seat
content:
Moment: When nobody makes room for the new kid
Say: "My words can open a seat."

title: Card 11 — Room for Me, Room for You
content:
Moment: When you're the new kid at lunch
Say: "I found my place — and made room."

title: Card 12 — Room for Everyone
content:
Moment: When a classmate does things differently
Say: "A different mind can be a gift."

title: Card 13 — Read the Room
content:
Moment: When a text lands wrong
Say: "When in doubt, ask — don't assume."

title: Card 14 — Behind the Filter
content:
Moment: When the feed makes them feel small
Say: "I don't have to earn 'enough.' I already am."

title: Card 15 — Keep the Love
content:
Moment: When a pet or person is gone
Say: "Love doesn't leave. It changes shape."

title: Card 16 — The Big Change
content:
Moment: When everything about home is changing
Say: "New can become home."

title: Card 17 — Enough
content:
Moment: When everyone else has the new thing
Say: "When I count what I've got, the wanting gets quiet."

title: Card 18 — The Story In You
content:
Moment: When they think they have no story to tell
Say: "The story was in me the whole time."

title: Card 19 — The Feelings Detective
content:
Moment: When a big feeling shows up out of nowhere
Say: "Name it to shrink it."

title: Card 2 — Solving Problems With Friends
content:
Moment: When two kids want the same thing
Say: "Let's take turns!"

title: Card 20 — Real or Fake? Think Before You Share
content:
Moment: When something online begs to be shared fast
Say: "Sixty seconds of checking beats a fast thumb."

title: Card 21 — Word Detective
content:

title: Card 22 — The Magic Words: A Grown-Up's Turn (Grown-Up Practice)
content:
Moment: When 'good job' isn't enough
Say: "You worked so hard on that."

title: Card 23 — When They Come Home Deflated (Grown-Up Practice)
content:
Moment: When they come home deflated
Say: "There is nothing wrong with you. You come from greatness."

title: Card 24 — The Peacemaker's Turn (Grown-Up Practice)
content:

Say: "How could we make this fair for both of you?"

title: Card 25 — The Voice in Their Head (Grown-Up Practice)
content:
Moment: When their self-talk turns harsh
Say: "The voice in their head starts as your voice out loud."

title: Card 26 — Coaching the Loss (Grown-Up Practice)
content:
Moment: When they lose the big game
Say: "I saw how hard you fought out there."

title: Card 27 — Growing Brain Power: A Grown-Up's Turn (Grown-Up Practice)
content:
Moment: When a task feels too big to start
Say: "Let's just do this one small part."

title: Card 28 — Try Again, Aaliyah (Little Lab)
content:
Moment: When the puzzle piece won't fit
Say: "I can try again!"

title: Card 29 — Room for Bisa (Little Lab)
content:
Moment: When it's their very first day
Say: "I belong!"

title: Card 3 — Level Up Your Mind Game
content:
Moment: When The Doubt whispers 'told you'
Say: "A mistake is a clue, not a verdict."

title: Card 30 — The Clapping Song (Little Lab)
content:
Moment: When their whole body has the wiggles
Say: "I've got rhythm!"

title: Card 31 — Quiet Words (Little Lab)
content:
Moment: When a party gets too loud
Say: "I can breathe!"

title: Card 32 — Emeka Keeps Going (Little Lab)
content:
Moment: When the tower keeps wobbling
Say: "I have patience!"

title: Card 4 — Growing Your Brain Power Every Day!
content:
Moment: When 'I can't do it' shows up
Say: "Little by little — that's how big things happen!"

title: Card 5 — Magic Words: Grow Your Brain Bigger
content:
Moment: When they think they're 'not smart'
Say: "Trying hard is the real magic!"

title: Card 6 — Stay Strong: A Resilience Toolkit
content:
Moment: When the world questions their worth
Say: "You are beautiful and brilliant, just as you are. Confidence is armor for a world that might question your worth."

title: Card 7 — The Worry That Shrank
content:
Moment: Before a scary first day
Say: "Feelings first. Fixing second."

title: Card 8 — The Finish Muscle
content:
Moment: When 'just one peek' turns into an hour
Say: "I can notice the Pull without following it."

title: Card 9 — The Whole Story
content:
Moment: When a friend walks right past you
Say: "'Mean' is usually 'hurting' in a costume."

title: Platform quick-rules
content:
Facebook: links in the post text are clickable — put mccraylearninglab.com right in the caption. Keep hashtags light (3-5).
Instagram feed: links in captions are NOT clickable — write "link in bio" and put the URL in your bio (or a Linktree). Hashtags can go up to ~30.
Stories (FB & IG): add a link sticker so it's tappable.
Everywhere: mccraylearninglab.com (or a specific story path).

title: Truth-in-copy rule (Aug 17, 2026)
content: The Lab is freemium. Six SEL comics are free forever (Solving Problems With Friends · Growing Your Brain Power Every Day! · Magic Words: Grow Your Brain Bigger · Train Like a Champion · Level Up Your Mind Game · Stay Strong: A Resilience Toolkit) plus Little Lab letters A-F, plus one rotating free story each month. Everything else needs the membership ($4.99/mo · $36/yr · $99/yr classroom). Never say "25 free" or "free to play" as a blanket claim; per-story "free" claims only on the six. No em dashes in any posted copy.
